summary.value: This paper proposes Classifier Constrained Alternative Training (CCAT), a novel method designed to address modality imbalance in multimodal learning. Modality imbalance arises when certain modalities (e.g., visual or audio) dominate the optimization of the classifier during training due to faster convergence or higher data quality, thereby suppressing the contribution of other modalities and limiting overall model performance. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is validated through experimental evaluation.
